task_context.problem_statement:
Paul had 2 books. After selling some in a garage sale he bought 150 new ones. If he has 58 books now
How many books did he sell?
( ( 2.0 + 150.0 ) - 58.0 )

A good way to start is to find the total amount of books Paul would have had if he hadn't sold any. He started with 2 and bought 150 more. Once you have that sum, you can look at the difference between that total and the 58 books he actually has now.
Okay, so 2 + 150 is 152. Then I just subtract 58 from that?
That is the correct logical approach. By subtracting the final amount from the total he would have had, you'll find the number of books that were removed from his collection during the sale.
